---
title: "ToFScope"
---

ToFScope is a local, browser-based application for exploring time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry
(ToF-SIMS) data. It allows you to compare mass spectra, ion images, and depth profiles, inspect peaks, and
explore signals in three dimensions.

![Explore shows an ion image, mass spectrum, front projection, and depth profile together.](docs/assets/tofscope-explore.png)

## Quick Start

ToFScope can be easily installed from [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/tofscope/) using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/):

```sh
uv tool install tofscope
```

That command will put the `tofscope` executable on your path. Run `tofscope` to launch the application.
By default, ToFScope will only have access to whatever files are in the folder that you launch it from
(or any subfolders). You can use the `--data-root` argument to allow read-only access to another folder
(such as a network mount containing your instruments' data) and the `--output-root` argument to allow
for saving analysis results to a separate folder. For example:

```sh
tofscope --data-root /path/to/acquisitions --output-root /path/to/saved-analyses
```

When running in this manner, the ToFScope process will run in the terminal and then open the main interface
in your default browser (similar to how [Jupyter](https://jupyter.org) operates). For more detail, see:

- [Install and launch](docs/getting-started/installation.qmd): requirements, folder setup, and starting the app.
- [Your first analysis](docs/getting-started/first-analysis.qmd): opening a file, comparing signals, and saving your work.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/getting-started/installation.qmd#troubleshooting): help with startup, file access, and saving.

## For developers and administrators

The developer and administrator guides cover [building and testing](docs/technical-documentation/building-and-testing.qmd), [configuration and deployment](docs/technical-documentation/deployment.qmd), and [maintaining this site](docs/technical-documentation/documentation.qmd).

ToFScope supports *TOFWERK TOFexplorer* HDF5 acquisitions. The [file compatibility and limitations guide](docs/technical-documentation/file-compatibility.qmd) describes supported workflows and current validation boundaries.
